subject: 9F5C99BFEC18E75332DC80B41D791C09
introduction: These six passages show a teaching being worked out. A brief statement of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá says that preventing procreation “is absolutely not permitted”; letters written for Shoghi Effendi say that the Bahá’í teachings imply the purpose of marriage is children but that Bahá’ís can neither condemn birth control nor confirm it; and the Universal House of Justice leaves the choice of whether and how to limit a family to the couple’s conscience, within that purpose. “Be fruitful, and multiply” and the Psalmist’s “children are an heritage of the Lord” are the scriptural ground of the first position; Paul’s “let every man be fully persuaded in his own mind” and “all things are not expedient” are his rules for questions that revelation has left open.
questions: The readings move from a flat prohibition to a matter of conscience. How do you understand the relation between the first reading and the last?
What does it mean to say the purpose of marriage includes children without making their number a matter of law?
Why might a religious authority deliberately decline to rule on a question?

outside.why: The prevention of procreation is not permitted. Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth.

The Qur’an addresses the fear behind many such decisions, in the context of infanticide: slay not your children, fearing a fall to poverty; We shall provide for them and for you. How far does trust in providence bear on family planning, and where does responsibility begin?
The purpose of marriage includes children. Lo, children are an heritage of the Lord: and the fruit of the womb is his reward.
Bahá’ís are in no position either to condemn or to confirm the practice. Let every man be fully persuaded in his own mind.
The House of Justice may think it untimely to rule. All things are lawful for me, but all things are not expedient.
Decisions left to the couple’s informed conscience. Which of you, intending to build a tower, sitteth not down first, and counteth the cost?

quran-slay-not-your-children.text: Slay not your children, fearing a fall to poverty, We shall provide for them and for you. Lo! the slaying of them is great sin.
